what_it_is: Endpoint, cloud and identity platform with Falcon Guardian (AIDR), AI-SPM and Charlotte AI.
identity_note: Falcon AIDR became Falcon Guardian on 2026-09-01. The AIDR docs banner says AIDR support ends 2026-11-30. AIDR docs mirror pangea.cloud/docs/aidr from the Pangea acquisition.
notes: Acquisitions: Pangea (AIDR), SGNL (Continuous Identity), Seraphic (enterprise browser), Onum (data pipeline). Pre-beta or beta per CrowdStrike posts: native AI gateway (GA stated for Q4 2026), container workload guardrails, desktop AI app inspection, Data Protection for Cloud AI data flows (early beta), Agentic Identity Provider (unreleased-features disclaimer), Falcon Complete for Guardian (Q3). Module 3: the 3.3 yes rests on the Guardian blog sentence on automatic containment plus the Falcon sensor. That blog carries an unreleased-features disclaimer. Module 2.1: Falcon Shield agent discovery covers Copilot (Power Platform), Agentforce, ChatGPT Enterprise, OpenAI Enterprise GPT and Nexos.ai, and the AIDR Copilot Studio collector is listed. The count of named platforms is judged at two. Module 4.3: the AIDR doc intro names toxic content as an example risk, but the detector list shows Malicious Prompt, Malicious Entity, MCP Validation, PII, Secret and Key, Language, Code, Competitors, Custom Entity, Topic, Emoji and Malicious Skills. Module 6 is services only. SAST, DAST and automated LLM red teaming are not sold as products. Charlotte AI is ISO 42001 certified, which is a company certification and not a framework mapping in the product. Marketing pages on crowdstrike.com rendered poorly in the scraper, so several claims rest on the AIDR docs, blogs and press releases.

1.reason: Falcon Cloud Security AI-SPM is agentless on AWS and GCP AI services. AI Discovery finds AI on endpoints.
1.evidence: Falcon Cloud Security delivers agentless visibility across OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, and Vertex AI.
1.has: Falcon Cloud Security AI-SPM, Exposure Management AI Discovery, Falcon Shield, Guardian agent discovery.

2.reason: MCP Proxy validates tool calls and AI Discovery finds MCP servers. Agent platforms: Copilot Studio, Agentforce. No sandbox.
2.evidence: The proxy runs locally as the @crowdstrike/aidr-mcp-proxy npm package, on the same machine as the MCP client.
2.has: AIDR MCP Proxy, Copilot Studio collector, Falcon Shield agent discovery, Guardian agent allowlist.
2.lacks: Two named managed agent platforms. Allow and block controls, no host sandbox.

3.reason: Guardian ties agent activity to sensor telemetry, blocks agent types on hosts, and feeds Next-Gen SIEM.
3.evidence: drive automatic containment by blocking malicious agent behaviors and compromised assets at runtime across agents.
3.has: Falcon Guardian runtime blocking, Bedrock log collector, Next-Gen SIEM, Fusion SOAR agent suspend.

4.reason: AIDR blocks via extension, SDK and gateways. Detectors cover injection, PII, code and topic, not toxicity.
4.evidence: Each detector identifies a specific risk type, such as PII exposure, malicious entities, prompt injection, or toxic content.
4.has: AIDR via browser extension, SDK, gateway collectors and MCP Proxy. 12 detectors.
4.lacks: No hallucination filter found. Toxicity filter not in detector list.

5.reason: AI-SPM keeps AI model and package inventory. AIDR keeps audit logs. No framework mapping or AIBOM export found.
5.evidence: Monitor and audit changes to your security policies
5.has: AI-SPM model and package inventory. AIDR policy audit log and runtime event logs.
5.lacks: No AI framework mapping, AIBOM export or compliance reports found.

6.reason: AI Red Team Services is a human-led engagement on LLM apps, tested against OWASP Top Ten.
6.evidence: Get in-depth evaluations of large language model (LLM) applications, tested against the Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) Top Ten.
6.has: AI Red Team Services: human-led LLM application tests and adversary emulation for AI.
6.lacks: Service, not a product. No automated attack library or CI/CD red teaming found.

7.reason: Agentic IdP (announced) issues short-lived scoped tokens to agents. Next-Gen Identity discovers human, non-human and AI identities.
7.evidence: Agentic IdP brokers access through tokens scoped to the minimum access, for the minimum time, required for each task.
7.has: Agentic IdP (announced), Continuous Identity from SGNL, Next-Gen Identity discovery of non-human identities.
7.lacks: Agentic IdP carries an unreleased-features disclaimer. No distinct per-agent credential confirmed.

8.reason: Cloud Security scans container models for backdoors. AI data flow is early beta. Code scanning is a service.
8.evidence: Proactively scans AI models for hidden malware, trojanized models, backdoors, and adversarial manipulations in containerized environments
8.has: Cloud Security AI model scanning, AI data flow discovery (beta), FAIRR code scanning service.
8.lacks: Model formats not named. No dataset poisoning scans. No AI SAST product.
